snippet.title: The Legend of Khiimori - Official Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get a look at the Early Access Launch Trailer for The Legend of Khiimori, a third-person open-world action-adventure game developed by Aesir Interactive and NightinGames. Players will traverse to the open wilds of 13th-century Mongolia to breed horses, hunt and scavenge for resources, and overcome challenges along the way. The Legend of Khiimori is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#IGN #Gaming
